questions.question: Identify the segment which contains a grammatical error. 'One of the boys are missing from the class.'
questions.explanation: The subject 'One' is singular, so the verb should be singular 'is' instead of 'are'. Correct: 'One of the boys is...'

hi.question: दिए गए वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि (Grammatical Error) है? 'One of the boys are missing from the class.'
hi.explanation: 'One of the' के बाद noun plural होता है (boys) लेकिन verb singular होनी चाहिए क्योंकि subject 'One' है। सही होगा: 'is missing'।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: CANDID
questions.explanation: Candid means truthful and straightforward. Frank has the same meaning.

hi.question: दिए गए शब्द का सही पर्यायवाची (Synonym) चुनें: CANDID
hi.explanation: Candid का अर्थ है स्पष्टवादी या खरा। Frank का अर्थ भी यही होता है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank: He is addicted _____ smoking.
questions.explanation: The word 'addicted' is always followed by the preposition 'to'.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द चुनें: He is addicted _____ smoking.
hi.explanation: 'Addicted' के साथ हमेशा preposition 'to' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questions.question: Select the meaning of the given idiom: 'A piece of cake'
questions.explanation: 'A piece of cake' means a task that is simple or easy to do.

hi.question: दिए गए मुहावरे (Idiom) का सही अर्थ चुनें: 'A piece of cake'
hi.explanation: 'A piece of cake' का अर्थ है बहुत आसान कार्य।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word: OPTIMISTIC
questions.explanation: Optimistic means hopeful about the future. Pessimistic means seeing the worst aspect of things.

hi.question: दिए गए शब्द का सही विलोम (Antonym) चुनें: OPTIMISTIC
hi.explanation: Optimistic का अर्थ है आशावादी। Pessimistic का अर्थ है निराशावादी, जो इसका सही विलोम है।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Receive'. Remember the rule: 'i before e, except after c'.

hi.question: सही वर्तनी (Spelling) वाले शब्द का चयन करें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Receive' है।

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words: 'A person who draws or produces maps'
questions.explanation: A Cartographer is a person who makes maps.

hi.question: वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द (One Word Substitution) चुनें: 'A person who draws or produces maps'
hi.explanation: नक्शा बनाने वाले व्यक्ति को Cartographer (मानचित्रकार) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Improve the underlined part of the sentence: She *is working* here since 2015.
questions.explanation: When 'since' or 'for' is used to indicate time, we use Perfect Continuous Tense. For 'She', it should be 'has been working'.

hi.question: वाक्य में सुधार करें (Sentence Improvement): She *is working* here since 2015.
hi.explanation: जब समय के साथ 'since' का प्रयोग होता है, तो Present Perfect Continuous Tense का उपयोग होता है। 'She' के साथ 'has been working' सही है।

questions.question: Identify the error in the sentence: 'Neither the doctor nor the nurse were available.'
questions.explanation: In 'Neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. 'Nurse' is singular, so it should be 'was available'.

hi.question: त्रुटि ज्ञात करें: 'Neither the doctor nor the nurse were available.'
hi.explanation: 'Neither...nor' में verb सबसे नजदीकी subject के अनुसार होती है। 'Nurse' singular है, इसलिए 'was' होना चाहिए।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: We should _____ the traffic rules.
questions.explanation: 'Abide by' is a phrasal verb meaning to obey or follow a rule.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: We should _____ the traffic rules.
hi.explanation: 'Abide by' का अर्थ है नियमों का पालन करना।

questions.question: Select the meaning of the idiom: 'Break the ice'
questions.explanation: 'Break the ice' means to do or say something to relieve tension or start a conversation in a social setting.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ चुनें: 'Break the ice'
hi.explanation: 'Break the ice' का अर्थ है चुप्पी तोड़ना या बातचीत शुरू करना।

questions.question: Select the antonym of: BARREN
questions.explanation: Barren means unproductive or sterile. Fertile means productive, capable of producing vegetation.

hi.question: विपरीतार्थक शब्द चुनें: BARREN
hi.explanation: Barren का अर्थ है बंजर। Fertile का अर्थ है उपजाऊ।

questions.question: One word substitution for: 'A sound that cannot be heard'
questions.explanation: Inaudible means unable to be heard.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन (One Word Substitution): 'A sound that cannot be heard'
hi.explanation: जो सुनाई न दे उसे Inaudible (अश्रव्य) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Definite'.

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Definite' (निश्चित) है।

questions.question: Improve the underlined part: He is *fonds of* playing cricket.
questions.explanation: The correct phrase is 'fond of'. 'Fonds' is incorrect.

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: He is *fonds of* playing cricket.
hi.explanation: सही मुहावरा 'fond of' (शौकीन होना) है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The cat jumped _____ the table.
questions.explanation: 'Upon' denotes movement onto a surface.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: The cat jumped _____ the table.
hi.explanation: जब कोई चीज गति के साथ किसी सतह के ऊपर आती है, तो 'upon' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Identify the error: 'She did not went to the market yesterday.'
questions.explanation: With 'did not', we always use the base form of the verb (V1). It should be 'go', not 'went'.

hi.question: त्रुटि ज्ञात करें: 'She did not went to the market yesterday.'
hi.explanation: 'Did not' के साथ हमेशा verb की फर्स्ट फॉर्म (go) का प्रयोग होता है, 'went' का नहीं।

questions.question: Select the synonym of: ENTIRE
questions.explanation: Entire means whole or complete.

hi.question: समानार्थक शब्द चुनें: ENTIRE
hi.explanation: Entire का अर्थ है पूरा या संपूर्ण (Whole)।

questions.question: Meaning of the idiom: 'Burn the midnight oil'

options.C: To work late into the night

questions.explanation: It means to work or study late into the night.

options.C: To work late into the night

hi.explanation: देर रात तक काम करना या पढ़ाई करना।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Grammar' (ends with -ar).

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Grammar' है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Either you or he _____ to blame.
questions.explanation: In 'Either...or', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. 'He' is singular, so 'is' is correct.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: Either you or he _____ to blame.
hi.explanation: 'Either...or' में verb पास वाले subject (he) के अनुसार होगी। 'He' के साथ 'is' आएगा।

questions.question: Improve the sentence: I *am agree* with you.
questions.explanation: 'Agree' is a verb. We say 'I agree', not 'I am agree'.

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: I *am agree* with you.
hi.explanation: सही प्रयोग 'I agree' है। 'Am' की आवश्यकता नहीं है क्योंकि Agree स्वयं एक verb है।

questions.question: Select the antonym of: FRIEND
questions.explanation: Friend means ally. Foe means enemy.

hi.question: विलोम शब्द चुनें: FRIEND
hi.explanation: Friend का विलोम Foe (शत्रु) होता है।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'One who loves books'
questions.explanation: A Bibliophile is a person who collects or has a great love for books.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'One who loves books'
hi.explanation: किताबों से प्रेम करने वाले को Bibliophile (पुस्तक प्रेमी) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Prevention is better _____ cure.
questions.explanation: This is a comparison, so 'than' is used. Also a common proverb.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: Prevention is better _____ cure.
hi.explanation: तुलना करने के लिए 'than' का प्रयोग होता है। यह एक कहावत भी है।
